entities.summary: Pertti Ilmari Nieminen was a Finnish professional ice hockey player who played in the SM-liiga. Born in Hämeenlinna, Finland, he played for HPK and TPS. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 1985.
